{{Otheruses|Bunker buster}}
A '''Bunker-buster torpedo''' was a two-stage weapon used to penetrate bunkers. They consisted of at least one [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], which penetrated the bunker, and the main warhead, a [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bomb]], that could enter the bunker via the opening the Thermal detonator created. A group of rogue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], led by [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], used them during the [[Raid on Supply Depot Thrago]]. The Bunker-busters they used were changed in that, when the proton bomb fell into the bunker, they sparked and then hissed for five minutes, in order to give the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] inside time to escape.<ref name="DN2">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref>
